DESCRIPTION.TITLE: Staﬃng Global
DESCRIPTION.TEXT: With our staffing and staff augmentation service, we strengthen our clients' teams through the search, selection, and incorporation of specialized talent, both locally and internationally. We adapt the service to the needs of each organization, with professionals who can integrate either on-site or remotely. We evaluate their competencies and support their integration, maintaining close follow-up with the client and the professionals to support their performance and the continuity of the service.

WHAT_IS_GLOBAL_PEOPLE_SOURCING.TITLE: How does our Staﬃng Global service work?
WHAT_IS_GLOBAL_PEOPLE_SOURCING.TEXT:
We start by understanding the client's challenge and defining the profiles, skills, and work modalities required. Then we search for and evaluate local and international talent, and present a selection of candidates for validation. This reduces the internal team's workload and facilitates an onboarding aligned with the project's and organization's needs.
We manage the hiring and coordinate the onboarding of professionals, either on-site or remotely, according to the agreed scope. During the service, we maintain close contact with the client and the professionals to monitor performance, address difficulties, and adjust support to the team's needs.

WHY_DO_GLOBAL_SOURCING_WITH_US.TITLE: Why do Global Sourcing with us?

CARD1.TITLE: EVALUATION AND PROFILE ADJUSTMENT
CARD1.TEXT: We evaluate the technical skills and cultural fit according to the requirements of each profile, project, and client.

CARD2.TITLE: PERMANENT TECHNICAL AND HUMAN SUPPORT
CARD2.TEXT: We provide permanent technical support according to the scope of the project, promoting the continuity of the assigned work.

CARD3.TITLE: ADHERENCE TO INTERNATIONAL LEGISLATION
CARD3.TEXT: In Chile, Peru, and Spain, we have direct hiring of personnel, without prejudice to hiring in other locations with protection under international law.

CARD4.TITLE: PERMANENT MONITORING
CARD4.TEXT: We are committed to our clients' goals through the empowerment and continuous feedback to our team.

PREVIEW_VIDEO.TITLE: Tell us what capabilities your team needs. We will design a staffing alternative according to the profile, work modality, and scope of the service your organization requires.
